data.desc: Kura Sushi USA, Inc. is a leading technology-enabled Japanese restaurant concept with 98 locations across 25 U.S. states and Washington DC. The Company offers guests a distinctive dining experience built on authentic Japanese cuisine and an engaging revolving sushi service model. Kura Sushi USA, Inc. was established in 2008 as a subsidiary of Kura Sushi, Inc., a Japan-based revolving sushi chain with more than 700 restaurants internationally and 49 years of brand history.
